answer: Each identity posts a 500 POA stake bond, and before the ledger credits an epoch of work two peers re-execute the trace and compare output hashes; a mismatch slashes the bond, a match releases it at the next close. At 12 POA per epoch a farm needs 42 clean epochs to recover one bond and one miss costs 500 at once, so sybil cost is linear: 1,000 identities lock 500,000 POA. A ridge of fresh keys, a mesa of new hosts, more timber for hardware, none of it changes the unit being bonded, which is the identity itself.
